name: Fully Charged, No Charger

leader.name: Mad Scientist
leader.passive: After mulligans, put the top 10 cards of your deck face down and Ready into your Stash. You do not receive setup temporary Stash and cannot use the normal once-per-Round Stash action. Your Stash does not Ready during your Ready step. At the start of your Turn, before Ready, Ready 1 Stash.
leader.note: The ten-card battery is all the normal Stash this Leader begins with. Cards can Ready Stash, but normal Stash growth is disabled.

specimen_rack.mechanical_identity: Each approved external card represents the same 2/2 Specimen Part Character token when released.

mulligan_priority: It's Alive! plus at least two Characters
Lab Assistant if It's Alive! is missing
Avoid hands with too many recharge cards before spending the initial battery
test_watchpoints: How often the optimal Turn 1 play spends 7 or more Stash
Win rate after creating one versus two Abominations on Turn 1
Turns where the Scientist has cards to play but insufficient Ready Stash
Turns where the Scientist has Ready Stash but insufficient cards in hand
How often Flip the Breaker and Car Battery in the Bathtub extend the battery meaningfully
Whether the opponent can survive the opening without the game becoming predetermined
Whether holding back Stash is ever better than spending aggressively
Whether Specimens are fun physical theater without becoming rules overhead
